node.statement: For each real lambda with 0 < lambda < 1/2, take the explicit matrices A_lambda and M_lambda from lem-prh-sharpness-family-arithmetic. They are positive unital maps of the required types, epsilon_lambda=||M_lambda A_lambda-I_2||_{infinity->infinity}=2*lambda^2 tends to 0, and P_lambda=A_lambda M_lambda has the stated rows with ||row_1(P_lambda)-row_3(P_lambda)||_1=2*lambda.
